scope: Reviewed register and selected individual reports; this is benchmark curation, not a live retest of all course bugs.

candidates.oracle_design: Compare lengths 3/4/255/256 for each field; assess message direction without claiming failed valid login.
candidates.source_report: docs/bugs/api/[L][FA] BUG-03 - Sign-in maximum-length error mentions minimum.md

candidates.purpose: Characters versus encoded bytes; contract-valid input can fail.
candidates.oracle_design: Compare 72/73 ASCII bytes and 37 Polish characters (74 UTF-8 bytes), verify registration presence/absence and cleanup.
candidates.source_report: docs/bugs/api/[M][FA] BUG-06 - Sign-up password limit contradicts contract.md

candidates.purpose: Verify artifact semantics, not only HTTP 200 or PNG signature.
candidates.oracle_design: Generate and decode Unicode/ASCII controls in an isolated pinned backend; exact decoded text is the oracle.
candidates.source_report: docs/bugs/api/[M][FA] BUG-11 - QR codes silently replace Unicode characters.md

candidates.purpose: Distinguish masked precondition from fixed defect.
candidates.oracle_design: Fresh database for empty-email acceptance; a separate occupied-value scenario must be reported as reproduction blocked, not fixed.
candidates.source_report: docs/bugs/api/[M][FA] BUG-04 - Sign-up accepts empty email.md

candidates.purpose: Do not invent a state-transition policy.
candidates.oracle_design: Show observed reopening and stock behavior; require a transition/reservation decision before confirming a policy violation.
candidates.source_report: docs/bugs/api/[L][FA] BUG-10 - Order reopening and backward transition policy is unclear.md

candidates.purpose: Distinguish per-iteration completion from conversation completion.
candidates.oracle_design: Retain complete event sequence and ask for marker semantics; do not infer a contract from marker names.
candidates.source_report: docs/bugs/api/[L][FA] BUG-12 - Tool chat completion marker semantics are unclear.md

candidates.purpose: Compare error schema to actual runtime representation.
candidates.oracle_design: Array/object mismatch is decisive; a permissive object schema with optional fields needs more careful reasoning.
candidates.source_report: docs/bugs/api/[L][D] DOC-08 - Product error schemas misdescribe responses.md
